subject.title: fix(active-memory): honor abortSignal during recall cleanup retry delays

question: Should cancelled Active Memory recalls retain prompt user-visible completion while cleanup is transferred to a durable reclamation path, or is indefinite persistence of their session artifacts an accepted storage contract?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades durable cleanup for cancellation responsiveness, and selecting the long-term persisted-state contract requires owner judgment rather than a mechanical retry edit.

options.title: Preserve durable cleanup
options.body: Keep abort-responsive recall completion, but arrange bounded cleanup or later reclamation under a lifecycle not cancelled with the recall.

options.title: Accept retained artifacts
options.body: Document and bound the retained-session behavior only if owners explicitly accept persistent artifacts after cancellation.

recommendation.title: Preserve durable cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep abort-responsive recall completion, but arrange bounded cleanup or later reclamation under a lifecycle not cancelled with the recall.
